sections.heading: Meet Framewright
items: The Linux port is now called Framewright, with a new icon. It is based on Palmier Pro (GPLv3) by Palmier, Inc.
Settings, models and caches move from the old palmier-pro folders to framewright automatically on first launch. Existing .palmier projects open as before.
Install as an AppImage or .deb, and connect Claude Desktop with the bundled framewright.mcpb extension.
AI generation with your own fal, Google and ElevenLabs keys.

sections.heading: First Linux release
items: The full editor on Linux: media library, multi-track timeline, preview, inspector and keyboard shortcuts.
Bring your own API keys for AI chat (Anthropic, OpenAI) and media generation. Keys stay in your system keyring.
Local transcription and captions with whisper.cpp, plus optional cloud speech-to-text with your own key.
On-device visual search: find clips by describing them. Nothing leaves your computer.
Built-in MCP server so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents can inspect and edit your project.

sections.heading: Export
items: MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, PNG still and audio-only exports.
Final Cut Pro XML (FCPXML) and Premiere / Resolve XML for round-tripping to other editors.
